scripts.package:desktop: pnpm run build:frontend && wails3 task darwin:package
scripts.install:desktop: if [ "$(uname -s)" = "Darwin" ]; then pkill -x Obails || true; rm -rf /Applications/Obails.app /Applications/Obails_new.app /Applications/Obails_old.app && cp -R bin/obails.app /Applications/Obails.app && touch /Applications/Obails.app && killall -9 Dock >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; killall Finder >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; fi
scripts.reinstall:desktop: pnpm run package:desktop && pnpm run install:desktop
